zh: 长篇完稿后可从简易书架或导演台通读全书并导出 TXT。首页的待处理事项可以直达对应作品。
拆书恢复后只补跑缺失的原文笔记和小节。可对比手改正文与 AI 生成版，保存选择后用于参考开书、续写和发布。
章节首稿和续写遵循模型路由的输出额度，生成中断后可从保存的进度恢复。短篇规划和大纲建议遇到输出上限时可自动提额重试。
大纲开书后可正常确认章节计划，V2 导演台可直接查看卷下章节。桌面端重启后记住关闭的开书引导提示。
en: Read a completed novel from the bookshelf or Director workspace and export it as TXT. Open the relevant project directly from a home-page item that needs attention.
Resume book analysis from the missing source notes and sections. Compare your edits with the AI-generated version, then save the text you want to use for new books, continuations, and publishing.

Chapter drafts and continuations honor the model route’s output allowance and can recover from saved progress after an interruption. Short-story planning and outline suggestions can retry with a higher allowance when needed.
Confirm chapter plans for projects started from an outline and view the chapters under each volume in Director V2. The desktop app remembers dismissed onboarding tips after a restart.
